description: Enforced data-separation and rights-verification policy for Persian Dataset V2. This is an engineering policy, not legal advice.

A.name: RIGHTS_CLEARED_CORE_LICENSE_CONDITIONS_APPLY
obligations: Retain attribution and source-specific licence conditions for every document.
Respect CC BY-SA 4.0 / GFDL share-alike conditions for redistributed adaptations of Wikimedia text.
Keep Tatoeba contributor names and CC BY 2.0 FR notices in provenance metadata, never in training text.
Keep Wikinews CC BY 2.5 distinct from CC BY-SA 4.0; respect its attribution requirement.
Respect GPL-3.0 notices that may apply to redistributed Ganjoor data files; underlying classical works are public domain.
Do not treat a compilation licence as a grant over the underlying text.
A.model_weights_note: Trained model weights are NOT assumed to be automatically free of upstream licensing, attribution, share-alike or redistribution obligations. Review the per-document provenance and applicable licence terms before distributing a model.

B.name: RESEARCH_ONLY
B.warning: Never mix PROFILE B documents into PROFILE A files.

C.name: QUARANTINE
C.warning: Do not train on these documents until rights, provenance and privacy issues are resolved.

global_rules.repository_root_discovery: Relative config paths resolve from the actual V2 checkout, never from a configured V1 repo_root.

license_review_rule: A public URL, MIT/ODC-BY/CC compilation label, generic Copyright/مجوز marker, or empty licence field is NOT evidence that underlying text is usable. Wikisource pages require an exact allowlisted template; NC/ND, generic, ambiguous and unverified licence-like templates are rejected with an exact reason. Other unverified sources are quarantined.

license_allowlist.applies_to: Wikisource pages with require_free_license_template=true. Other Wikimedia dumps are governed by their dated dump licence, not by this per-page allowlist.
license_allowlist.method: Exact normalised template names only; no broad free-licence prefix regex. First reject-rule match wins; a page is accepted only if no licence-like template is rejected and at least one template is in the allowlist.
license_allowlist.normalisation: lowercase; trim; remove a leading subst:; replace spaces, underscores and ZWNJ with hyphens; collapse repeated hyphens.

templates.name: PD-US
templates.license: Public domain in the USA (old publication)

templates.name: PD-Iran
templates.license: Public domain in Iran (verified template terms apply)

templates.name: PD-self
templates.license: Public-domain dedication by the copyright holder

templates.name: PD-release
templates.license: Public-domain release by the copyright holder

templates.name: PD-anon-US
templates.license: Public domain in the USA (anonymous old work)

templates.name: cc-by-sa-all
templates.license: CC BY-SA all versions (attribution and share-alike required)

templates.name: GFDL
templates.license: GNU Free Documentation License (attribution / licence-text conditions apply)

templates.name: FAL
templates.license: Free Art License (attribution / copyleft conditions apply)

notes: PD, CC BY, CC BY-SA, GFDL and the other listed templates are accepted only with their stated licence conditions.
CC BY-NC / NC-SA, CC BY-ND / ND and all-rights-reserved markers are rejected regardless of corpus-size pressure.
Generic Copyright, generic مجوز, generic پروانه and unverified licence-like templates are quarantined with an exact reason.
GFDL is accepted as a free-compatible template where applicable; Wikisource's own policy may require CC BY-SA for new original contributions. This is not a legal determination.
Add a new template only after verifying its exact licence text; do not add a broad prefix or regex to increase corpus size.
